name: seanlee10-skills
description: Agent skills by Sean Lee, including hwp-parser (HWP/HWPX to Markdown), google-photo (collect and curate Google Photos via the Picker API), kipris-search (search KIPRIS for Korean patents, trademarks and designs), email-draft (customer emails as Gmail-ready rich text) and ga4-blog-report (GA4 blog traffic per post, source and AI engine); youtube-download saves a YouTube video as a local H.264/AAC MP4.
